Procedure Name.cell: EPMA Major Element Silicates/Oxides+Mapping, Tissint (U. Tennessee, Cameca SX100)
Procedure Name.value: EPMA Major Element Silicates/Oxides+Mapping, Tissint (U. Tennessee, Cameca SX100)

Laboratory.cell: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences, University of Tennessee, Knoxville
Laboratory.value: Department of Earth and Planetary Sciences, University of Tennessee, Knoxville

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Liu et al. 2016, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.; doi:10.1111/maps.12726
Procedure Reference(s).value: Liu et al. 2016, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.; doi:10.1111/maps.12726

Coupled Technique(s).cell: SEM (BSE imaging); petrographic microscopy; LA-ICP-MS (Agilent 7500ce, Virginia Tech)
Coupled Technique(s).value: SEM (BSE imaging); petrographic microscopy; LA-ICP-MS (Agilent 7500ce, Virginia Tech)

Target Material.cell: olivine; pyroxene; Fe-Ti-Cr oxides; maskelynite; phosphate; sulfide; glass — the analytical conditions are given for these groups (p.3)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Whole sample (thin section) > Phase — "elemental X-ray maps (Ca Ka, Al Ka, Fe Ka, and Mg Ka) of four sections" (p.3); the reported quantity is a modal fraction, "the number of pixels attributed to each mineral ... divided by the total number of pixels in the whole section" (p.3)

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: N — the map areas are shown rather than specified: a "Red box outlines the area of X-ray maps" on an olivine megacryst (Fig. 3 caption, p.7), with no stated rule for placing them

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Petrographic microscopy and SEM — "The petrography of these sections was examined using a petrographic microscope and a scanning electron microscope" before the microprobe work (p.3)

Analytical Mode.cell: N — quantitative point analyses and elemental X-ray maps; WDS or EDS is not stated, and the list has no value without one

Beam Mode.cell: maskelynite, phosphate, sulfide, glass: Defocused; other: N — 'Maskelynite, phosphate, sulfide, and glass were analyzed using a defocused beam of 5–10 µm size'; for olivine, pyroxene and Fe-Ti-Cr oxides only a '1–2 µm beam diameter' is given, not a mode

Beam Current.cell: olivine, pyroxene, Fe-Ti-Cr oxides: 20 nA; maskelynite, phosphate, sulfide, glass: 10 nA — p.3

Beam Diameter.cell: olivine, pyroxene, Fe-Ti-Cr oxides: 1–2 µm; maskelynite, phosphate, sulfide, glass: 5–10 µm — p.3

Beam Damage Minimization.cell: N — a defocused 5–10 µm beam at 10 nA is used for maskelynite, phosphate, sulfide and glass, but the paper gives no reason for it

Mapping Beam Mode.cell: Focused (section maps and olivine megacryst maps) — 'a 20 nA focused beam'; 'a focused beam of 15 kV voltage and 200 nA current'
Mapping Beam Mode.value: Focused (section maps and olivine megacryst maps)

Mapping Beam Current.cell: 20 nA (section maps: Ca, Al, Fe, Mg Kα); 200 nA (olivine megacryst maps) — p.3
Mapping Beam Current.value: 20 nA (section maps: Ca, Al, Fe, Mg Kα); 200 nA (olivine megacryst maps)

Target Species.cell: Si, Ti, Al, Mg, Ca, Fe, Mn, Cr, Ni, Na, K, P — read from the detection-limit sentence, which names their oxides (p.3)

Monitored Elements.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Elements.cell: Si, Ti, Al, Mg, Ca, Fe, Mn, Cr, Ni, Na, K, P — point analyses on both instruments (the detection-limit sentence names their oxides); maps: 'Ca Ka, Al Ka, Fe Ka, and Mg Ka' (four sections) and 'Fe Ka, P Ka, Al Ka, Ca Ka, and Cr Ka' (two olivine megacrysts, collected on 'the EMP' — the instrument is not named)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Cr2O3, FeO, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, NiO, P2O5, K2O, V2O3, La2O3, Ce2O3; modal-area fraction per mineral (vol%); Mg#; En, Fs, Wo — oxide wt% 'of selected minerals' (Table 2), with V2O3, La2O3 and Ce2O3 for the oxides and merrillite; glass means with 1σ (Table 3); modal abundances from the X-ray maps (Table 1)

X-ray Line.cell: Ca, Al, Fe, Mg, P, Cr: Ka; other: N — maps: 'Ca Ka, Al Ka, Fe Ka, and Mg Ka' (four sections) and 'Fe Ka, P Ka, Al Ka, Ca Ka, and Cr Ka' (two olivine megacrysts); no line is stated for the point analyses

Dwell Time per Pixel.cell: Fe, P, Al, Ca, Cr: ~0.5 s; other: N — 'a dwell time of ~0.5 s at each step' for the olivine megacryst maps; the section-map dwell time is not stated

Step Size / Pixel Size.cell: 8-12 µm (BSE + Ca/Al/Fe/Mg Ka phase maps at UT); 2 µm (olivine megacryst Ka maps; instrument ambiguous)
Step Size / Pixel Size.value: 8-12 µm (BSE + Ca/Al/Fe/Mg Ka phase maps at UT); 2 µm (olivine megacryst Ka maps; instrument ambiguous)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — the modal fractions use every pixel of the mapped section ("the number of pixels attributed to each mineral was divided by the total number of pixels in the whole section", p.3); nothing is admitted or excluded

Detection Limit.cell: SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, MgO, CaO: <0.03 wt%; FeO, MnO, Cr2O3, NiO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5: <0.05–0.1 wt%; other: N — 'Detection limits are typically <0.03 wt% for SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, MgO, and CaO; <0.05–0.1 wt% for FeO, MnO, Cr2O3, NiO, Na2O, K2O, and P2O5' (p.3)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Additional Notes.cell: Liu et al. 2016, Meteorit. Planet. Sci. — Tissint mineral chemistry. Protocol 1 of 2: University of Tennessee Cameca SX100. Same paper also uses Caltech GPS JXA-8200 (see Liu+2016_Cal column). Point analysis AND X-ray mapping performed at UT. Specific mapping: BSE + Ca/Al/Fe/Mg Ka maps (15 kV, 20 nA, step 8-12 µm). Olivine megacryst mapping (15 kV, 200 nA, step 2 µm, dwell ~0.5 s) described as "using the EMP" — instrument ambiguous (may be UT or Caltech instrument). Standards, matrix correction, and software not stated.
Additional Notes.value: Liu et al. 2016, Meteorit. Planet. Sci.
